caption:
Why sleeping in after a bad night can make the next night harder.

Sleep drive is the pressure to sleep that builds from the moment you get up. A sleep-in starts that build later, and a nap spends some of it early, so less is there at bedtime. A modest catch-up on days off may still make sense when the working week leaves too little time for sleep.
